$comment: Pass bar for `npm run eval`. Committed as data so tightening it is a
reviewable diff rather than an argument. disqualifyRecall is the strictest
number on purpose: rating a competitor or a job applicant as a real lead
wastes a rep's time and, worse, can send them an email.
disqualify recall 100%, MAE 0.04. Gates sit below that with headroom for
run-to-run variance (scores move a few points between identical runs) and
for swapping models — a weaker model should fail this, that's the point.
Caveat on maxScoreMae: scoreRange bands span most of their tier, so MAE is
a coarse calibration check, not a tight one. Tier accuracy and disqualify
recall are the metrics that actually bite.
